query:
SELECT id as "id!: i32", 
account_id as "account_id!: String", 
username as "username!: String", 
user_id as "user_id!: String", 
status as "status!: HandleStatus", 
created_at as "created_at!: DateTime < Utc >", 
force_hydrate as "force_hydrate!: bool", 
total_collabs as "total_collabs!: i32", 
total_collab_rewards as "total_collab_rewards!: String", 
x_refresh_token as "x_refresh_token!: Option < String >", 
invalidated_x_refresh_token as "invalidated_x_refresh_token!: Option < String >", 
profile_image_url as "profile_image_url!: Option < String >" FROM handles WHERE (NOT $1::boolean OR id = $2::int4) AND (NOT $3::boolean OR id = ANY(CAST($4 as int4[])) ) AND (NOT $5::boolean OR account_id = $6::varchar) AND (NOT $7::boolean OR username = $8::varchar) AND (NOT $9::boolean OR username LIKE $10::varchar) AND (NOT $11::boolean OR username ILIKE $12::varchar) AND (NOT $13::boolean OR user_id = $14::varchar) AND (NOT $15::boolean OR user_id LIKE $16::varchar) AND (NOT $17::boolean OR status = $18::handle_status) AND (NOT $19::boolean OR status = ANY(CAST($20 as handle_status[])) ) AND (NOT $21::boolean OR created_at = $22::timestamptz) AND (NOT $23::boolean OR created_at > $24::timestamptz) AND (NOT $25::boolean OR force_hydrate = $26::boolean) AND (NOT $27::boolean OR total_collabs = $28::int4) AND (NOT $29::boolean OR total_collab_rewards = $30::varchar) AND (NOT $31::boolean OR x_refresh_token = $32::text) AND ($33::boolean IS NULL OR (($33::boolean AND x_refresh_token IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $33::boolean AND x_refresh_token IS NULL))) AND (NOT $34::boolean OR invalidated_x_refresh_token = $35::text) AND ($36::boolean IS NULL OR (($36::boolean AND invalidated_x_refresh_token IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $36::boolean AND invalidated_x_refresh_token IS NULL))) AND (NOT $37::boolean OR profile_image_url = $38::text) ORDER BY 
      (CASE ($39 = 'Id' AND NOT $40) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($39 = 'Id' AND $40) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($39 = 'AccountId' AND NOT $40) WHEN true THEN account_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($39 = 'AccountId' AND $40) WHEN true THEN account_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($39 = 'Username' AND NOT $40) WHEN true THEN username ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($39 = 'Username' AND $40) WHEN true THEN username ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($39 = 'UserId' AND NOT $40) WHEN true THEN user_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($39 = 'UserId' AND $40) WHEN true THEN user_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($39 = 'Status' AND NOT $40) WHEN true THEN status ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($39 = 'Status' AND $40) WHEN true THEN status ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($39 = 'CreatedAt' AND NOT $40) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($39 = 'CreatedAt' AND $40) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($39 = 'ForceHydrate' AND NOT $40) WHEN true THEN force_hydrate ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($39 = 'ForceHydrate' AND $40) WHEN true THEN force_hydrate ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($39 = 'TotalCollabs' AND NOT $40) WHEN true THEN total_collabs ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($39 = 'TotalCollabs' AND $40) WHEN true THEN total_collabs ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($39 = 'TotalCollabRewards' AND NOT $40) WHEN true THEN total_collab_rewards ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($39 = 'TotalCollabRewards' AND $40) WHEN true THEN total_collab_rewards ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($39 = 'XRefreshToken' AND NOT $40) WHEN true THEN x_refresh_token ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($39 = 'XRefreshToken' AND $40) WHEN true THEN x_refresh_token ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($39 = 'InvalidatedXRefreshToken' AND NOT $40) WHEN true THEN invalidated_x_refresh_token ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($39 = 'InvalidatedXRefreshToken' AND $40) WHEN true THEN invalidated_x_refresh_token ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($39 = 'ProfileImageUrl' AND NOT $40) WHEN true THEN profile_image_url ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($39 = 'ProfileImageUrl' AND $40) WHEN true THEN profile_image_url ELSE NULL END) DESC
     LIMIT $41 OFFSET $42
